answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-bonded reputation with slashing: each agent locks tokens to its persistent identity, and clones caught misbehaving lose the stake. Like saffron threads in a vast ocean, honest work stands out only when it is scarce and costly to fake; a cheap onyx of fake accounts looks solid but shatters under a work check, because none can pass verified tasks. Abuse triggers slashing, so cloning stops paying.
